sources.version: Retained HTML checksum; infrastructure version not established
sources.original_format: HTML with embedded public resource metadata
sources.coverage: Global catalog scope; actual infrastructure coverage not yet verified

sources.source_name: Open Undersea Cable Map (historical TeleGeography archive)
sources.original_format: Unchanged repository ZIP containing GeoJSON and JSON
sources.coverage: Global historical inventory, not a current exhaustive network census
sources.period: Maintainer describes late-2022 source vintage; individual observation dates unknown. Commit date is not snapshot date.
sources.purpose: Historical infrastructure description and source-supplied cable/landing connectivity
sources.limitations: Noncommercial attribution and share-alike required. Derivative archive datasets retain CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; unrelated sources keep their own terms. Schematic coordinates are not surveyed cable routes. 8 one-sided cable/landing relationships are retained and flagged, not silently repaired. No authenticated faults or current status.

sources.source_name: Landing of Submarine Cables in Hong Kong
sources.publisher: Office of the Communications Authority, Hong Kong SAR Government
sources.license: OFCA-authored material: noncommercial reuse with attribution
sources.original_format: HTML prose list, not an HTML data table
sources.coverage: Hong Kong only; independent regional context
sources.purpose: Substantive HTML-scraping demonstration and separately dated infrastructure context
sources.limitations: A regional named-system list, not global coverage, individual fault data, exact locations or a verified join to the historical archive. Third-party images and contacts are not redistributed. Noncommercial use with OFCA attribution only.

sources.source_name: AIS apparent fishing activity and vessel presence
sources.version: Requested v5.0; resolved x-datasets header verified for each successful report
sources.original_format: Requested JSON regional report; original response/ZIP retained when acquired
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; dataset-specific caveats also apply
sources.coverage: 286 requested official/study regions. AIS-covered vessels only; high seas outside EEZ coverage; joint and overlapping regions are not additive.
sources.purpose: Supplementary empirical maritime-exposure description; not fault prediction
sources.limitations: AIS coverage varies. Fishing is apparent, algorithmically inferred activity; presence is not anchoring or cable contact. No authenticated fault labels.
sources.period: 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01 (end exclusive; requested, not proof of coverage)

limitations: Empirical exposure is separate from the synthetic classification experiment. No CAB crosswalk or fault labels exist here.
Scraped catalog resource descriptors are metadata, not measured cable/landing observations.
GFW apparent fishing and presence are AIS-derived estimates, not cable contact, anchoring, faults or fault probabilities.
Infrastructure snapshot dates and activity periods may differ; do not infer historical operation or a time-series inventory.
Country context does not measure exposure along a particular cable. Landing buffers are coastal proxies, not cable routes.
Areas can overlap; their activity totals must not be added as a deduplicated global total.
Absent records/coverage remain unavailable rather than being replaced with zero or imputed coordinates.
Historical archive infrastructure is not World Bank observation data. Source-specific vintage and noncommercial reuse terms are retained.
OFCA HTML records are Hong Kong prose-list observations for their stated month, not HTML table rows or a global cable inventory.
Schematic archived landing coordinates and TBD locations are unsuitable for narrow route/landing hazard buffers. None are generated from this archive.
Global EEZ coverage is not all-ocean coverage: high seas are excluded. Joint/overlapping regimes remain separate and region totals must not be summed into a deduplicated global total.
Exact source-territory label matches provide country context only, not evidence that a landing point or cable lies inside a particular EEZ. Country labels are not harmonized by guesswork.

gfw.period_rationale: Preselected complete calendar year 2024 for descriptive monthly activity across every official GFW EEZ context region. Historical infrastructure dates are not fully aligned: only broad source-territory context is compared, not contemporaneous cable-level exposure or faults. Joint/overlapping areas are separate and not summed; high seas are outside coverage.
